item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
child = Path('child.txt').read_bytes()
assert child.decode().strip() == 'done-by-child', repr(child)
Path('result.txt').write_bytes(child)
assert Path('result.txt').read_bytes() == Path('child.txt').read_bytes()
print({'child': child.decode(), 'equal': True})
PY"
